title: 第2302章 江尘与龙夏切磋第2301章 中部势力救援
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
圣域其他地方的势力联合起来，整体要比天武宗强大得多，强者也多得多。
天武宗这边，主要是靠江尘与龙夏两个人强大，才能获得如此好的战绩。
如果没有这两个人存在，天武宗联军根本不可能是南部魔族的对手。
现在能清除掉南部的魔族，主要是江尘与龙夏消灭了魔族中的高层强者，才获得胜利。
“如果我们前往支援的话，那么南部区域也得有强者镇守，否则被人偷家的话，那么损失就大了，天武宗是我们的根基，不容有失。”江尘道。
江尘与龙族，炼丹师公会，阵法师公会都有仇。
还有异界的魔族，还有其他的敌人等。
到时候，这些势力派一个圣人境强者前来南部搞破坏，没有江尘与龙夏坐镇的话，天武宗的处境会非常危险。
“那么，我们当中其中一个人前往支援即可。”龙夏道。
“这样吧，你前往支援，天武宗其他人，留在南部区域，你一个人就能顶得上百万大军了，除了中部区域外，其他三域，都快要完全沦陷了，我们现在不但不需要帮忙，还能前去支援他们，已经相当有诚意了。”龙夏道。
“我一个人前往支援？龙族，炼丹师公会，还有阵法师公会可是跟我有仇的，万一他们暗中使坏，加上异域的强者，我会很被动的。”江尘无奈地道。
“吞天龙珠的特性，你以为我不了解吗？凭你现在的实力，他们想杀你，无异是痴人说梦，以你现在的实力，在圣域里，还真是难找到对手了，而且，你之前不是喜欢大杀特杀吗？他们敢打你的主意，你杀到他们胆寒就是，你又不是不敢。”龙夏没好气地道。
江尘闻言，觉得龙夏说得有道理。
带上天武宗的其他人前往，如此激烈的战场，确实容易损失。
这些可都是天武宗的根基啊。
异域强者入侵，未必不是天武宗壮大的机会。
不容有失。
“言之有理，不过，为了保险起见，这段时间，你做我的陪练，让我体内的灵力与肉身融合得更好，为我突破到大乘境七重打下基础。”江尘道。
“很巧，我也需要一个陪练，这段时间，还没有跟你好好地交手，我倒要看看，你现在的实力达到什么程度了。”龙夏闻言，也是一脸的战意。
支援其他地方的事情，暂时不着急。

提升自己的实力最为稳妥。
现在江尘修为大乘境六重，已经能打败普通的圣人境一重强者了。
如果修为再提升一层的话，就算十个圣人境一重的强者联手，估计也杀不了江尘。
那个时候，如果江尘不是对手的话，想要跑，对方是拦不住的。
当然，江尘甚至能将对方所有人斩杀殆尽，也是有可能的。
二人约定好之后，来到一处荒无人烟的区域。
在这儿交手，不会影响到其他人。
此时，龙夏与江尘双眼满是战意。
双方亦师亦友。
一起并肩作战多次，但是，真正相互之间交手的次数却少得可怜。
“小子，现在动用你的全力，让我看看你的极限在哪里？”龙夏道。
“我怕我出全力的话，你承受不住。”江尘笑道。
“笑话，如果我输给你这个小子的话，那么我前世真是白活了。”龙夏不屑地道。
“那你看好了。”江尘说完，直接朝龙夏杀去。
魔龙拳，霸道至极。
content_en:
When the forces in other parts of the Holy Domain unite, the overall force is much stronger than the Tianwuzong, and there are many more powerful people.
On the Tianwuzong side, it was mainly because of the strength of Jiang Chen and Long Xia that they were able to achieve such a good record.
Without the existence of these two people, the Tianwuzong coalition would never be a match for the southern demon clan.
Now that the demon clan in the south can be eliminated, it is mainly because Jiang Chen and Long Xia eliminated the high-level powerful ones among the demon clan that they won.
"If we go to support, then the southern area must be guarded by strong people. Otherwise, if someone steals our home, the loss will be great. Tianwu Sect is our foundation and cannot allow any loss." Jiang Chen said.
Jiang Chen has enemies with the Dragon Clan, the Alchemist Guild, and the Formation Master Guild.
There are also demons from other worlds and other enemies.
When the time comes, these forces will send a Saint Realm expert to the south to wreak havoc. Without Jiang Chen and Long Xia in charge, Tianwuzong's situation will be very dangerous.
"Then, just one of us can go to support." Long Xia said.
"Let's see, you go to support, and the rest of the Tianwuzong stay in the southern area. You can withstand an army of millions by yourself. Except for the central area, the other three areas are about to be completely lost. Not only do we not need help now, but we can also go to support them. We are already quite sincere." Long Xia said.
"Am I going to support them alone? The Dragon Clan, the Alchemist Guild, and the Formation Master Guild all have a grudge against me. If they secretly cause harm, and there are strong men from foreign lands, I will be very passive." Jiang Chen said helplessly.
"Do you think I don't understand the characteristics of the Sky-Swallowing Dragon Ball? With your current strength, it's just an idiot's dream for them to kill you. With your current strength, it's really hard to find an opponent in the Holy Domain. Besides, didn't you like killing people before? They dare to attack you. If you kill them until they are scared, it's not like you don't dare." Long Xia said angrily.
When Jiang Chen heard this, he felt that what Long Xia said made sense.
Bring other people from the Tianwuzong to go, it is indeed easy to lose in such a fierce battlefield.
These are the foundation of Tianwuzong.
The invasion of strong men from foreign lands may not be an opportunity for Tianwuzong to grow.
There is no room for error.
"It makes sense, but to be on the safe side, during this period of time, you will be my sparring partner so that the spiritual power and physical body in my body can be better integrated, laying the foundation for me to break through to the seventh level of the Mahayana realm." Jiang Chen said.
"It's a coincidence that I also need a sparring partner. I haven't had a good fight with you during this period. I want to see how strong you are now." Long Xia also had a fighting spirit on his face when he heard this.
There is no rush to support other places.
It is the safest way to improve your own strength.
Now that Jiang Chen has cultivated to the sixth level of the Mahayana Realm, he can already defeat ordinary first-level Saint Realm experts.
If the cultivation level is improved by another level, even if ten strong men at the first level of the Saint Realm join forces, they probably won't be able to kill Jiang Chen.
At that time, if Jiang Chen was not his opponent, he would not be able to stop him if he wanted to run away.
Of course, it is possible that Jiang Chen can even kill everyone on the other side.
After the two made an agreement, they came to a deserted area.
Fighting here will not affect other people.
At this time, Long Xia and Jiang Chen's eyes were full of fighting intent.
Both sides are both teachers and friends.
They fought together many times, but the number of times they actually fought each other was pitiful.
"Boy, use your full strength now and let me see where your limit is?" Long Xia said.
"I'm afraid you won't be able to bear it if I try my best." Jiang Chen smiled.
"It's a joke, if I lose to a kid like you, then my previous life will be in vain." Long Xia said disdainfully.
"Then you keep an eye on it." After Jiang Chen said that, he went straight towards Long Xia.
The Demonic Dragon Fist is extremely domineering.
